chunks: We have given examples of every kind for men in this Qur'an so that they may contemplate.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of the parables in the Qur'an?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the pedagogical wisdom of God, who employs diverse 'amthal' (parables) to accommodate varying levels of human intellect and spiritual readiness. The repetition of the phrase 'la'allahum yadhdhakkarun' (perhaps they may remember) underscores the conditional nature of guidance, suggesting that while the Qur'an provides all necessary signs, the ultimate benefit depends on the listener's active contemplation (tafakkur). This aligns with the Shia emphasis on the Qur'an as a living text that requires deep, reflective engagement to unlock its layers of meaning.
